data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Moujibah means 'granted', 'conferred', or 'bestowed'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'wajib', which signifies 'necessary' or 'required'. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes the blessings and favors granted by Allah to His servants. The name Moujibah carries the meaning “Granted, Conferred, Bestowed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Moujibah usually hope their child will grow to embody granted, conferred, bestowed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
